xlsx_confirm.section: Rows without an id matched to an element by name or number
xlsx_confirm.accept_tip: Apply this row to the matched element (one undo step with the rest)
xlsx_confirm.reject_tip: Do not match: this row creates a new element
xlsx_confirm.decide_first: Accept or reject the rows matched by name first.
xl.msg.key_match_many: key matches {} elements; not matched, the row creates a new one
xl.msg.key_match_taken: key matches an element used by another row; not matched, the row creates a new one
xl.msg.key_match_kept: kept: match rejected, row creates a new element
xl.msg.key_match_undecided: rows matched by name wait for a decision
